about.title: Who I am?
about.p1: Hi, I'm César, a web and mobile systems developer with over %YEARS% years of experience, specialized in building APIs, graphical interfaces and responsive, efficient, integrated applications.
about.p2: I work from front-end to back-end: I build cross-platform mobile apps and dynamic web interfaces on a solid foundation of Laravel, Node, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and MariaDB, with an end-to-end approach to scalable solutions.
about.p3: From socket servers for real-time apps to custom systems, I enjoy turning ideas into products with clean, efficient and maintainable code — and I keep learning new technologies, like Ionic and React Native. Shall we build something amazing together?

contact.title: Contact
contact.heading: Shall we build something together?
contact.text: I'm open to new opportunities, freelance projects and conversations about technology. Pick the channel you prefer — I usually reply within a day.

footer.tagline: Building web and mobile systems since 2011 — from API to interface.
